topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: I came up with what I thought was a brilliant solution, an invention that could change things in a small but significant way. I poured my evenings and weekends into it, sketching, testing, refining. Every step forward felt like a victory, a step toward making a difference. When I finally had a prototype, solid and real, I was eager to share it with the world, to see it put to use. But a quick search shattered the ground beneath my feet. It turns out, someone else had the same idea, patented years ago. Now, I’m left with a quiet workshop and a collection of parts that won’t go anywhere. I guess I’ll have to find another path, another idea, but the thought of starting over seems... heavy.
